# Robin Farrow

## Overview

- **Age:** Seven to eight years old  <sub>[v2 c22 P1](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0001)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c22 P4](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0004)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Robin-boy  <sub>[v3 c22 P23](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0023)</sub>

## Appearance

Robin is a young boy with small brown heels and a pink tongue. He has a front tooth pulled out, which he sold to Milty Gammon.

_Sources: [v2 c22 P4](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0004), [v2 c19 P44](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0044), [v3 c22 P18](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0018)_

## Personality

Robin is mischievous, energetic, and prone to bad moods and rebellious bouts, though he quickly feels regret for his wrongdoings. He loves stories, especially fairytales, and often makes earnest or absurd assertions about his future. He displays deep affection for Nell and grows easily jealous if he thinks she prefers someone else.

_Sources: [v2 c19 P34](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0034), [v2 c19 P36](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0036), [v2 c19 P47](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0047), [v2 c8 P56](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0056), [v3 c22 P30](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0030), [v3 c22 P35](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0035), [v3 c22 P41](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0041)_

- To make an Indian headpiece out of feathers  <sub>[v2 c22 P16](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0016)</sub>
- To marry Mabel Fletcher when he reaches adulthood  <sub>[v3 c22 P35](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0035), [v3 c22 P37](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0037), [v3 c22 P39](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0039)</sub>

## History

Robin lives at Grey Shutters alongside his twin sister Lucy, cared for by Thirza Abernethy and Nell Harcourt. He frequently engages in domestic pranks, such as placing a toad beneath Thirza's pillow, pulling feathers from the white rooster to make an Indian headdress, and fleeing Sunday School to go fishing with Milty Gammon. After his father Richard Farrow passed away from consumption, Robin and Lucy were left a trust fund, ensuring Grey Shutters would remain their permanent home. Upon starting school, he became close friends with classmate Milty Gammon and declared himself betrothed to Mabel Fletcher. He also grew two inches in height over a year and sold one of his lost teeth to Milty for two cents. Robin remains deeply attached to Nell, often seeking her reassurance, confessing his misdeeds to her, and listening eagerly to her explanations and fairytales.

_Sources: [v2 c22 P15](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0015), [v2 c22 P16](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0016), [v2 c22 P20](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0020), [v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022), [v2 c22 P25](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0025), [v2 c19 P34](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0034), [v2 c19 P44](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0044), [v2 c8 P56](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0056), [v2 c8 P60](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0060), [v3 c22 P17](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0017), [v3 c22 P18](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0018), [v3 c22 P25](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0025), [v3 c22 P26](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0026), [v3 c22 P27](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0027), [v3 c22 P35](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0035), [v3 c22 P39](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0039)_
